top_signals.title: Warsh Says Fed Won't Be Constrained by Market Prices
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says markets can be a good source of information but not a determinative or perfect source during a news conference following the central bank's decision to leave rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Earnings Reflect Changing Consumer Priorities
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Despite being less than halfway through earnings seasons, and with retailers yet to report, many consumer-facing companies have announced results that make it clear inflation is changing spending patterns. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Meta shares drop on falling profits and weak sales forecast
top_signals.summary: Mark Zuckerberg under pressure over huge AI spending
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Carvana posts record quarterly profits, forecasts up to $3 billion in earnings this year
top_signals.summary: Carvana said Wednesday it expects earnings of between $2.7 billion and $3 billion this year after reporting record quarterly results for the second quarter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Meta's stock drops on light revenue guidance, dwindling free cash flow
top_signals.summary: Meta issued a weaker-than-expected revenue forecast and narrowed its capex range for the year.

top_signals.title: Chipotle hikes same-store sales forecast as diners return for burrito bowls
top_signals.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill stock has fallen more than 7% this year, dragging its market value down to roughly $44 billion.
